accordion: Stacked sections that open from numbered headings, each with a glyph that turns.
alert: An inline notice on a spined frame: info, success, warning or danger, each with its own glyph.
alert-dialog: A flagged confirmation that has to be answered, and that an agent has to ask a person about.
avatar: A portrait in a cut frame, with initials over a generated scanline field when there's no image.
badge: A small cut label in seven tones, with count and status variants.
breadcrumb: A trail of pages, the current one in the signal color.
button: A key on a display: a cut frame with a raised tab, in five tones, that flashes as it's pressed.
button-group: Keys joined in one strip, horizontal or vertical, with hold-to-repeat.
calendar: A month grid with today marked and the chosen day lit.
card: A content card with a scanlined media slot, plain or interactive.
carousel: A viewer: slides in a cut frame, with keys, segment indicators and a position readout.
checkbox: A cut box that fills and marks when checked, with an indeterminate state.
choice-list: Replies to choose from: rows in the signal color, the chosen one a solid yellow bar.
code-block: Highlighted code with line numbers, a filename tab and a copy key. No highlighting dependency.
collapsible: One section behind a key that shows and hides it.
combobox: A text control that filters a list of options as you type.
command-palette: A searchable list of commands behind a prompt, in a dialog.
context-menu: An area that opens a menu on right-click, a long press, or the keyboard.
data-table: Rows with selection, sortable columns, status badges and a menu per row.
date-picker: A date field with a calendar that opens beside it.
dialog: A modal panel on a spined frame that tears in over a dimmed page, with its answers on keys below.
drawer: A sheet that slides in from the edge of the page, and can be dragged.
feed: Dated events in order on a vertical rule: who did what, and when.
fieldset: A spined frame grouping several fields under a legend.
glitch-text: Text that decodes itself into place and tears for a moment, with a stable copy for screen readers.
hex-stat: An attribute as a hexagon holding an icon, a value and a name, and a honeycomb to lay several out.
holo-card: A surface that tilts toward the pointer in 3D, with a sheen and layers at different depths.
hover-card: A name that previews a small dossier on hover or focus.
item-list: An always-visible list of rows in columns, the selected row a solid signal bar.
item-slot: A gear slot: a cut tile with a rarity spine, mod sockets, a count and an empty state.
key-hint: An input hint: a key glyph and what it does, optionally pressable.
loader: A boot screen in miniature: a mark, a thin progress bar, a percentage and a cycling status line.
menu: A key that opens a menu of actions, with checkable items, groups and a submenu.
menubar: A bar of menus with one tab stop.
meter: A segmented gauge with thresholds that change its tone and print a word.
micro: The printed decoration around frames: micro-print lines, barcodes, rulers, data streams and corner brackets.
navbar: A navigation bar with status readouts, page links and trailing content.
otp-input: One cut cell per character of a code, with a blinking caret in the active one.
pagination: Page keys with previous, next and ellipses, and a position readout.
panel: The kit's container: a frame with a spine or a title bar, a heading, micro-print and a body.
password-input: A password field with a key to show or hide it.
popover: A key that opens a framed surface beside it, with a title, description and body.
progress: A segmented bar with a percentage readout, and an indeterminate state.
radio-group: Options where one is chosen, each with a diamond indicator.
rating: A level picked from a row of diamond pips.
readout: A large numeral with a unit and a label that counts to its new value when it changes.
resizable: Panels split by a handle that drags or steps with keys.
reticle: A lock-on bracket that snaps onto whatever it wraps when hovered, focused or active.
screen: The chrome every full screen shares: a status strip, the content, and a foot with key hints.
scroll-area: A scrolling region with a thin scrollbar and edge indicators.
segmented-control: A row of segments with an indicator that slides to the choice.
select: A labelled trigger that opens a list of options to choose from.
separator: A rule with tick marks, plain, labelled or vertical.
side-tabs: Icon keys stacked down the edge, with a panel beside them.
signal-graph: A compact live graph, as a trace or a spectrum, with a text summary.
skeleton: Placeholder lines and blocks for content that's loading.
slider: A ticked track with a cut thumb and a value readout, single or range.
stepper: A value on a readout between minus and plus keys, with MIN and MAX tags.
switch: A block that slides across a cut track and lights, with its state printed beside it.
tabs: Tabs over panels with a sliding indicator, or as cut keys.
terminal: A console log with tagged lines, a prompt with history, and a follow-the-end scroll.
text-field: A labelled text input in a cut frame, with a hint, an error and an optional icon.
textarea: A labelled multi-line input with a character count.
toast: Keys that raise a notification in each tone.
toaster: The page's notification region and a notify() helper.
toggle: A latching key that stays lit while pressed.
toggle-group: Toggles that share one value, one or several at a time.
toolbar: Keys, toggles and separators in one bar, moved through with arrow keys.
tooltip: A small cut label that appears on hover or focus.
tree: A hierarchy with connector lines and branches that open.

loadout: Gear slots, a weapon's sheet with its stats, and what's in the pack.
augments: Five attributes on a hexagonal lattice, with points to spend and an info panel.
jobs: A job board: tabs, a list of jobs, objectives to tick off, and the brief.
comms: Contacts, a message thread, and replies to choose from.
archive: A database of people, places and machines, one dossier each.
grid: A generated district map with filters, markers and a route.
daemon: An agent console: what the agent sees, what it does, a permission prompt, and undo.
